summary: OpenAI is rolling out a Health feature in ChatGPT that lets U.S. users securely connect Apple Health and supported medical records so the model can incorporate that context into conversations, powered by GPT-5.5 Instant and GPT-5.6 Sol with dedicated health-focused training and evaluation.

categories.reason: The product explicitly connects medical records and personal health data to ground conversations, moving ChatGPT into consumer care-navigation workflows.
categories.quote: You can choose to securely connect Apple Health and supported medical records so ChatGPT can help you understand your information in context, keep track of what has changed, and have more informed, personalized conversations.

practices.reason: The lab claims domain-specific gains in reasoning over complex health details and in judgment/escalation behavior, but the evaluation is the lab's own and health-specific, so it warrants investigation rather than immediate adoption for general use.
practices.quote: GPT‑5.6 Sol builds on that progress with even stronger performance on more complex questions ... stronger performance on tasks that require reasoning across complex details, clear communication, and careful judgment.

practices.reason: The described physician-built rubric evaluation (HealthBench Professional) covering accuracy, safety, communication, context awareness and escalation is a transferable measurement approach for high-stakes domains, though the instrument itself is not handed over.
practices.quote: we work with hundreds of physicians around the world to develop realistic health scenarios and detailed rubrics that define what a strong response should do. These evaluations assess qualities including accuracy, safety, communication, context awareness, completeness, and appropriate escalation.
